chapters.title: QUAD OVERSOLD
chapters.text: All four lanes' %D (9 · 3, 14 · 3, 40 · 4, 60 · 10) close at or below 20 on the same bar. The panel arms long until the 60 · 10 crosses back through 50, or for 100 bars.

chapters.title: ROTATION
chapters.text: Armed long since the quad, the 9 · 3 %D closes back above 20 (28) and rises again on this close (30). One ROTATION per arm.

chapters.title: LATCH RELEASED
chapters.text: The slow 60 · 10 %D closes back above 50 (51.2): the long arm is released. The latch reads not armed until the next quad.
